headline: Contractor malware at Nippon Columbia exposed millions of karaoke customer records
standfirst: One story today: a malware infection at Nippon Columbia, a contractor of entertainment system maker Daiichi Kosho, exposed millions of customer and employee records.
bodyMarkdown:
## Breaches

Daiichi Kosho disclosed that malware at contractor Nippon Columbia exposed more than 8.7 million customer and employee records [[s1]]. The headline cites 8.6 million karaoke fan records; the excerpt gives a higher, broader figure. No CVE was supplied.

Analysis: infection vector, dwell time and notification status are not supplied.
